home.title: Sift
home.tagline: A bilingual catalogue of Saudi credit cards where every figure traces back to the bank that published it.

sortNote.default: Sorted by bank name, then card name. This is not a ranking.
sortNote.fee: Sorted by annual fee, lowest first. Cards whose fee the bank has not published are listed last.
sortNote.rate: Sorted by the highest rate a card can earn, grouped by unit: cashback %, then points per SAR, then miles per SAR — these units can't be compared with each other. The base rate is shown on every card. Cards with no published rate are listed last.
